name: Vocal shard scatter
desc: Glitched verbal concrete: speechless, diphone and speakspell fragments sliced and reversed with random dropouts and stutters, iter rotation and reverse gating under dub delay. Uncanny, fractured, half-heard speech.

code.full: stack(s("speechless diphone [speakspell diphone2] alphabet").slice(8, "0 5 [2 2] 7 3 [6 6] 1 4").rev().speed("<1 .9 1.2>").gain(${gain}*.8), s("baa").slice(4, "<0 3 1 2>").gain(${gain}*.45).speed(1.3).sometimesBy(.3, x=>x.speed(.8))).degradeBy(.12).iter(4).every(4, x=>x.rev()).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(11)).room(${room}).roomsize(5).delay(${dly}).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.45).orbit(8).play()
code.peak: stack(s("speechless*2 diphone [speakspell numbers] speechless").slice(16, "0 8 [4 4] 12 2 10 [6 6] 14 1 9 5 13 3 11 7 15").rev().gain(${gain}*.8), s("[diphone2 baa]").slice(4, "<0 2 3 1>").speed("<1 1.2 .85 1.4>").gain(${gain}*.5), s("speechless(5,8,<0 2 4>)").speed(1.4).rev().gain(${gain}*.4)).degradeBy(.15).iter(8).every(2, x=>x.rev()).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.6).slow(8)).pan(perlin.range(.2,.8).slow(6)).room(${room}).roomsize(5).delay(${dly}).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.5).orbit(8).play()
